shortDescription: Germany-based financial services company Allianz XETR:ALV is considering a £5 billion ($6.77 billion) takeover swoop for AA, the breakdown recovery group, Sky News reported on Saturday.Reuters could not immediately verify the report.($1 = 0.7390 pounds)
